document: Bitaqat al-hawiyya (بطاقة الهوية, Palestinian identity card)
office: the Ministry of the Interior's General Directorate of Civil Affairs, through the civil affairs department of the governorate where the person is registered

routes.label: in person, at the civil affairs department where the applicant is registered (or the head office in Ramallah)

note: Palestine's identity card. The Civil Status Law No. 2 of 1999 (read 2026-10-31 in An-Najah University's legislation database, Maqam, which records it as in force in the West Bank and Gaza; its only amendment there, Law No. 6 of 2001, changes art. 29 on deaths and adds a chapter on late registration, not the card) requires every Palestinian who has reached 16 to obtain an identity card, issued on an application to the department where the person is registered (art. 43), and lets no body but the Directorate of Civil Affairs issue one (art. 44); fees for documents are set by regulation (art. 7), which wasn't found. The Ministry of the Interior's page for its General Directorate of Civil Affairs (read 2026-10-31) says the Directorate applies the 1999 law and its executive regulation of 2009 and lists the first identity card among its services, with replacements for a worn-out or lost one. Landinfo's thematic note of 4 May 2026 (secondary, resting on meetings with the Palestinian embassy in Norway in 2025 and the Ministry) says the card can be applied for from 16, issued by the General Directorate of Civil Status under the Ministry, in person both for a first card and a renewal, that it can't be applied for from abroad, and that it has no formal limit on its validity, though it's usually renewed after about ten years: so the card is held as permanent, `from` 16 and `must` 16 (the law's age; Landinfo's sources put the obligation at 18, which the law read doesn't say, so the law's 16 is kept). The law's art. 46 sends applications from abroad to the Palestinian missions, but Landinfo's sources say this isn't possible in practice, so no route abroad is modelled. No fee was found (the fee regulation of art. 7 wasn't found; the Cabinet's services guide the Ministry links to, palestinecabinet.gov.ps, answered 503 on 2026-10-31), so the fee is null; the currency is the shekel the map holds for Palestine, with no amount in it. The Gaza Civil Affairs Committee's issuing since 2007, and Israel's control of the register, aren't modelled.

sources.title: Maqam (An-Najah National University legislation database), Law No. 2 of 1999 on Civil Status (قانون بشأن الأحوال المدنية رقم (2) لسنة 1999م)
sources.said: ساري النفاذ في الضفة الغربية وغزة ... بطاقة الهوية: وثيقة قانونية للتعريف بصاحبها تصدرها المديرية. ... لقاء رسم يحدد بنظام ... وجوب الحصول على بطاقة هوية ... على كل فلسطيني بلغ السادسة عشرة من عمره أن يحصل على بطاقة هوية وفقاً لأحكام هذا القانون، وتصدر البطاقة بناء على طلب يقدمه الشخص إلى الدائرة المقيد بها. ... بخلاف المديرية لا يجوز لأية جهة رسمية أو غير رسمية إصدار بطاقات الهوية.

sources.title: Maqam (An-Najah National University legislation database), Law No. 6 of 2001 amending the Civil Status Law No. 2 of 1999
sources.said: تعديل المادة 29 (التبليغ عن الوفيات) ... يضاف "الفصل الرابع مكرر" بعد الفصل الرابع من قانون الأحوال المدنية رقم (2) لسنة 1999 بعنوان ساقطي القيد وإعادة القيد

sources.title: Palestinian Ministry of the Interior, General Directorate of Civil Affairs (الإدارة العامة للأحوال المدنية)
sources.said: تطبيق قانون الأحوال المدنية الصادر عام 1999، ولائحته التنفيذية للعام 2009 ... الخدمات التي تقدمها دوائر الأحوال المدنية ... إصدار هوية أولى. ... إصدار هوية بالية. ... إصدار هوية مفقودة.

sources.title: Landinfo, Temanotat Palestina: Folkeregistrering, identitetsdokumenter og pass (4 May 2026), as ecoi.net holds it, section 5
sources.said: Det kan søkes om ID-kort fra fylte 16 år, og det er obligatorisk fra 18 års alder ... Det er ingen formell gyldighetsbegrensning på ID-kortet, men det er vanlig å fornye det etter omtrent ti år ... ID-kort utstedes av Direktoratet for sivilstatus (General Directorate of Civil Status), underlagt Innenriksdepartementet ... kreves det personlig oppmøte både ved førstegangsutstedelse og ved fornyelse av ID-kort. ... er ikke mulig å søke om fornyelse eller nytt ID-kort fra utlandet
